Welcome back. Here's where things are.

## What this is
A small local Python CLI (`python3 -m studyplan seed/missed.json`). It reads your NCLEX-PN / Canadian RPN missed-question tags from `seed/missed.json` (topic, client need, and why you missed it) and prints a 7-day remediation plan. `--days` changes the length and `--json` gives the same plan as data. It has "Why you missed them" grouping, "Areas to strengthen", "Missed more than once", daily focus lines and study tips. I just ran it: all 42 tests pass and the plan prints correctly.

## Rules that apply
- **Standard library only, local, no network.**
- **Plain JSON files, no database**, so you can edit the journal in a text editor on your phone.
- **No qbank content.** No UWorld, Archer, Kaplan or other paid qbank question text, not even paraphrased. Only topic tags and your own notes.
- **PN scope only.** Wording sticks to reinforce, monitor, report and follow the care plan, with nothing RN-level. A keyword test (`studyplan/scope.py`) enforces this.
